title: Unveiling the impact of photoinduced halide segregation on performance degradation in wide-bandgap perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2308-2317
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05604C, Paper
Yuxiao Guo, Cong Zhang, Linqin Wang, Xingtian Yin, Bihui Sun, Changting Wei, Xin Luo, Shiyu Yang, Licheng Sun, Bo Xu
By varying the thickness of WBG perovskite films, we identified two distinct migration modes of halide ions under light irradiation, as well as their effects on device JSC output, which provides the feasible research direction for stable WBG PSCs.
